name: pi-work
description: pi extension: goals, session tasks, track stages, autopilots and the delegate tool gate in one unit (pairs with sandy/work)

scripts.test: npm run test:goal && npm run test:parts
scripts.test:parts: node --test --experimental-strip-types index.test.mjs gate.test.ts link.test.ts sandy-cli.test.ts tasks/*.test.ts track/tests/*.test.ts autopilot/*.test.ts autopilot/autopilots/*.test.ts delegate/*.test.ts delegate/*.test.mjs
